blocks.x: Applied AI & GenAI applied to Capabilities. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

In Telecom, Media & Entertainment, applied ai & generative ai at dataq soft covers the full lifecycle of enterprise intelligence: strategy and value mapping, platform build-out, model adaptation, retrieval architectures, multimodal systems, and the governance fabric that keeps every model auditable. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: enterprise ai strategy & roadmapping, generative ai platform engineering, llm fine-tuning & model operations — delivered on Dataq Compass and Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.

Programs run on a fixed rhythm so progress is visible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
